summary: Cred (solo episode, Don is traveling) discusses Bitcoin's strong breakout and recommends owning some BTC as a hedge against FOMO and potential corporate treasury bubble. Warns strongly against catch-up trades into altcoins that haven't moved, emphasizing that weak assets stay weak in dispersion cycles. Key invalidation is a weekly close below the breakout candle low. For traders wanting entries, suggests either biting the bullet and buying spot, or using low time frame strategies since high time frame pullbacks to breakout levels tend to fail.
key_takeaways: Own some BTC spot to avoid FOMO-driven poor decisions if corporate treasury bubble continues
Avoid catch-up trades - weak assets stay weak in dispersion cycles
Nearest invalidation: weekly close below breakout candle low (2021-style failed breakout risk)
If pullback happens immediately to breakout level, that's a red flag not a buy signal
Trade strength, not weakness - have high bar for rotating to underperformers
